description: Same analysis as analyze_biomarkers (tiered, guideline-cited recommendations and questions for the doctor), but it returns immediately with a job_id instead of making you wait. Use it for larger panels, or whenever you cannot wait 30 seconds or more. Then call get_lab_analysis with the job_id after about 20 seconds; it says "pending" until the result is ready, and keeps the result for 30 minutes. Made-up or de-identified values only: never names, dates or record numbers.

biomarkers.description: Map of biomarker name -> numeric value, e.g. { "Hemoglobin A1c": 7.6 }. Made-up or de-identified only.

name: start_lab_analysis
title: Start a lab-results analysis and collect it later (made-up or de-identified numbers)
